product_version: EU AI Act Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744; Colorado SB26-189; NIST AI RMF 1.0 and NIST AI 600-1; ISO/IEC 42001:2023; C2PA 2.5
version_sensitive_claims: Q1/Q32: Digital Omnibus changed dates; the checked official timeline places Annex III high-risk requirements in December 2027 and Annex I in August 2028.
Q2/Q6: four risk groups are an explanatory shorthand; classification requires specific use case, Article 6 and role.
Q4: Article 53 open-source exception is partial and does not remove systemic-risk obligations.
Q5: Article 99 fine ceilings differ by breach; GPAI providers have separate Article 101.
Q13: Executive Order 14110 was revoked on 23 January 2025.
Q14: Colorado SB26-189 repealed and re-enacted the earlier SB24-205 regime; new ADMT requirements start 1 January 2027.
Q22: Article 12 requires logging capability; Article 19 governs provider-held logs and its six-month period has an applicable-law qualification.
Q23: C2PA signature supports provenance of assertions, not truth of the represented event.
Q24: Article 73 uses general 15-day, widespread/critical-infrastructure 2-day and death 10-day reporting deadlines with reasonable-likelihood language.
Q28/Q29: copyright and cross-border data rules depend on jurisdiction, source, contract and context; GDPR Chapter V is not a blanket EU-only storage requirement.
staleness_risks: EU AI Act, national AI laws, administrative guidance and C2PA versions may change; verify the current text before using dates or obligations for a live product.
UK and China coverage is deliberately high-level; no exhaustive jurisdictional inventory was attempted.
LLM_READY is authoring evidence, not independent blind examiner review or FINAL acceptance.
notes: ROUND 9: all 32 visible questions, A-D options, option explanations and paired Markdown theory reviewed; correct keys retained.
The five-part sections were kept for each wrong option; stale explanations for EU dates, Colorado, incident reporting, log retention and human oversight were corrected.
